readOnlySchemaAudit.rollback: Read-only plan: preserve private drafts/immutable request receipts and native outbox/assignment data across app rollback. Original draft migration down() drops both recovery tables and must not be used as a routine UI rollback. Existing accepted request IDs may already have committed; reverting code or deleting receipts does not undo native assignments/competitor actions or delivered events. Any business reversal requires separately approved compensating operations and downstream reconciliation. No rollback executed.

performanceAudit.method: Static repository inspection and local cgroup sampling only; no production query probes, EXPLAIN, load/stress tests or latency/SLA claim.
observations: Comparison workspace performs per-pair JSON journal/archive lookups; native planning observations cap at 200 and history at 20. Full collection still needs production query/index/retention review.
Private lists paginate at 20 by UUID with actor/kind JSON filters; original actor(updated_at,id) index does not establish efficient actor/kind/id lookup at production scale.

Financial reads limit displayed order/refund samples to 20 but monthly eligible aggregates still scan all eligible records; production date/payment/refund join indexing and query budgets are unverified.

Goal/commercial saves recapture source readers within request/draft transaction locks; remote delay can extend lock/connection occupancy. Configured Josh replica pool max=2, statement timeout=120 seconds, connection timeout=5 seconds; no production latency measured.
Assignment caps 20 and uses sorted company locks with current-copy/version checks. Replica/outbox throughput and retention remain unmeasured.
